title: Misty Landscape with Text Overlay
coreRelationships: The large white text contrasts strongly with the dark, muted background.
The misty atmosphere creates a soft, blurred background for the sharp text.
The horizontal lines of text align centrally, creating a balanced composition.
The bottom line of text acts as a caption or subtitle to the main title.
reuseFormula: Generate a muted, low-saturation landscape image (e.g., misty mountains, foggy field) with a dominant brown/sepia palette. Overlay a large, bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif title, centered in the upper-middle. Add a smaller, bold, white, uppercase geometric sans-serif caption, centered at the bottom.
